name: Omarchy MCP
description: Remote AI agent dispatch to Omarchy VM — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok CLI, plus file ops and whitelisted shell. Conservative defaults: dispatch and write tools blocked, reads inherited.
saferAlternatives: Use per-category Bearer tokens (OMARCHY_MCP_TOKEN_DISPATCH/FS/SHELL/READ) to scope blast radius independently of Guard policy.
claude_execute and codex_execute are opt-in — only enable when remote dispatch is needed.
For read-only access, set only OMARCHY_MCP_TOKEN_READ and leave dispatch/shell tokens unconfigured.
